subject: Retained file views, responsive tab navigation and literal identifier typography

behavior.navigation: Retained file tabs and file-tree selections reuse mounted source, graph, explanations, source scroll and graph camera without inspection, compilation or model requests.
behavior.invalidation: The host publishes only retained path/revision keys in state polling. Refresh, chat instructions, checked work and repair discard observations; failed/reread inputs replace their affected view. Returning to an invalidated tab prepares fresh inputs. The refresh response clears the browser index immediately, and command generations discard superseded polling responses.
behavior.explicit_analysis: The host selects its original immutable observation by target and exact source/graph revisions, then rechecks sources, configuration, resources and the prepared Lake fingerprint before/after model comparison. Client presentation state confers no authority.
behavior.visuals: Dependency cards have 14px/18px padding and 104px height, matching node centers/layout checks. Literal underscore identifiers use code typography in cards and info popups. True formulas keep bounded untrusted KaTeX; inline code inherits readable card contrast.

decoded_screen_review: Lake source-inventory refusal and retained historical result
GUI/TUI continuation and retained repository edits
HTTP 429 stop, restart and explicit retry

gui_full_attempt.failures: Refresh, failed lexical recovery and post-edit invalidation exposed retained-view regressions, fixed with host path/revision invalidation.

gui_followups.notes: Retained tabs and missing-Mathlib recovery passed. One accessibility contrast failure was fixed; a concurrent runner cleared trace artifacts and caused the completed main-target case to fail teardown.

Main-target freshness/restart and edited-source/mobile accessibility passed. The new Lake variant initially lacked a manifest, so its build changed frozen metadata and was correctly refused. The regression now explicitly starts from a project built using the public meden lake command and requires ready before testing navigation.
The real prepared-Lake retained-tab and explicit-analysis journey passed. Rapid refresh exposed a missing reread: the display could still retain its previous path index.
Retained tabs passed again. Poll-response generation guards alone did not resolve rapid refresh; the refresh command now immediately clears the browser observation index before navigation is enabled.

outcomes: Warm artifact validation after explicit refresh
Imported source change rebuilds exact graph
Restart reuses valid cache without inference approval

nonpassing_setup_attempts: A concurrent browser launch found port 4321 occupied; it did not run a product journey.
Type checking rejected an explorer callback with an extra argument; the signature was corrected before the succeeding build/checks.

limitations: Timings measure five automated returns to an already prepared Riemann file, not first-open compilation or a universal latency guarantee.
Initial Lake builds and explicit input-freshness checks may still take time; no whole-project Riemann Main build completion is claimed.

Actual installed Lean/Lake and offline workers were exercised. Model responses in regression fixtures were scripted; this is not live-model, local-inference, cold-install or whole-application refinement evidence.

An exploratory browser helper initially used a five-second idle wait during real preparation. It was rerun with an explicit inspection-dispatch/completion wait; no project/configuration rescue was used.
